note: Architecture-level footprint of untrained reference code. No trained checkpoint, no validated multi-target performance, and no runtime/energy/latency measurement is claimed. Architecture footprint is not deployment feasibility.

structure.summary: 4 per-modality Conv1D encoders -> modality-fusion Transformer -> 9 linear regression heads.

weight_memory.int8_note: Theoretical lower bound only; no quantized checkpoint exists and accuracy under int8 is unmeasured.

input_buffer.reason: The encoders use AdaptiveAvgPool1d, so the architecture accepts variable-length per-modality windows; no fixed input length is declared, so an input-buffer size is not derivable from the architecture alone.

explicitly_not_reported: runtime feasibility on any specific MCU
